references.title: References & attributions
references.intro: gym-tracker's training guidance is grounded in peer-reviewed research and evidence-based coaching. Sources are cited, not reproduced; the full texts remain with their publishers.
references.notice: AI-generated exercise guides are original text with these works listed as further reading. They are educational and not a substitute for coaching or medical advice.
references.kind_note.paper: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses informing volume, frequency, rest, and intensity guidance.
